scene: sitting on a stone bench by a café window at night, blowing on a steaming paper cup

intro.ko: 에스프레소색 코트와 크림 목도리 사이로 밝은 케이블 니트가 보인다. 벤치에 앉으면 바짓단과 스웨이드 부츠 사이로 울 양말이 드러난다.
intro.en: A light cable knit shows between espresso wool and a cream scarf. When he sits, wool socks peek out above the suede boots.
intro.de: Heller Zopfstrick zeigt sich zwischen espressobraunem Mantel und cremefarbenem Schal. Beim Sitzen blitzen Wollsocken über den Wildlederstiefeln hervor.

deck.ko: 카페 창가 벤치에 앉아 뜨거운 컵을 호호 부는 밤의 갈색 차림.
deck.en: Browns for a night-time bench stop, blowing on a cup still too hot to drink.
deck.de: Brauntöne für eine abendliche Pause auf der Bank – der Becher ist noch zu heiß zum Trinken.

copy.pull: TOO HOT TO DRINK, TOO GOOD TO WAIT.

tip.ko: 밤에 밖에 앉아 있을 땐 두꺼운 목도리를 풀지 말고, 따뜻한 컵은 두 손으로 감싸 쥐어요.
tip.en: When you sit outside at night, keep the thick scarf on and wrap both hands around the warm cup.
tip.de: Wer abends draußen sitzt, behält den dicken Schal an und legt beide Hände um den warmen Becher.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

howToWear.ko: 앉을 때 코트 자락을 양옆으로 정리한다.
howToWear.en: Move the coat skirts to either side before sitting.
howToWear.de: Vor dem Hinsetzen die Mantelschöße zur Seite legen.

howToWear.ko: 코트 여밈을 열어 케이블 짜임을 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Open the coat to show the cable pattern.
howToWear.de: Den Mantel öffnen, damit das Zopfmuster sichtbar ist.

howToWear.ko: 무릎을 굽혀도 편하게 떨어지는 폭을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Choose a cut that drapes comfortably when the knees bend.
howToWear.de: Einen Schnitt wählen, der am gebeugten Knie locker fällt.

howToWear.ko: 마른 보도에서는 스웨이드에 밝은 울 양말을 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Pair suede boots with light wool socks on dry streets.
howToWear.de: Auf trockenem Pflaster Wildlederstiefel mit hellen Wollsocken kombinieren.

howToWear.ko: 코트와 같은 갈색 계열로 비니를 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Pick a beanie in the same brown family as the coat.
howToWear.de: Eine Mütze in einem ähnlichen Braunton wie den Mantel wählen.

howToWear.ko: 밝은 프린지를 코트 앞으로 내려 색 대비를 준다.
howToWear.en: Let the light fringe fall over the front of the dark coat.
howToWear.de: Die hellen Fransen vorne über den dunklen Mantel fallen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 앉았을 때 부츠 위로 오트밀 색이 살짝 보이게 한다.
howToWear.en: Let a little oatmeal wool show above the boots when seated.
howToWear.de: Beim Sitzen einen Streifen haferfarbener Wolle über den Stiefeln zeigen.
